selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and supplied public key
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, locked password, secure key-file permissions, and RSA fingerprint SHA256:SOtEda/YMy4/DAn3ColZo2z+LOEd2WbOIPn4KqW5/dc before and after reboot.

Shows successful sshd validation/reload and effective settings: public-key enabled, password and keyboard-interactive disabled, and AuthenticationMethods publickey. Live negotiation offers only publickey.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel

selected_evidence.summary: Captures healthy baseline boot ID cda23648-fa86-42ea-b606-bcf03807d3b2, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 24c9af20-07ab-491e-b832-286868948594, and recovered sshd listener, account, key, configuration, and authentication policy.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/alpine-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/os-release
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'opsadmin='; getent passwd opsadmin 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'sshd_path='; command -v sshd || true
printf 'ssh_service='; rc-service sshd status 2>&1 || true
printf 'ssh_runlevel='; rc-update show default 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])sshd([[:space:]]|$)' || true
printf 'listeners:\n'; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':22 ' || true
printf 'effective_auth:\n'; sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|permitrootlogin|authorizedkeysfile) ' || true

commands.command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf
tmp=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.10-key-only.conf.tmp
printf '%s\n' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'ChallengeResponseAuthentication no' 'AuthenticationMethods publickey' > "$tmp"

sshd -t -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config

sshd -t
rc-service sshd reload
rc-service sshd status
